task: Deploy a new version of checkout-svc without causing any downtime for users during the deployment.

candidate_memories.content: checkout-svc uses blue-green deployment: the new version is deployed to the green slot; traffic is shifted from blue to green only after green passes health checks.
Blue-green deployment achieves zero-downtime by keeping the old version live until the new version is fully healthy; rollback is instant by shifting traffic back to blue.
Traffic shift is controlled via the checkout-svc-weight annotation on the Istio VirtualService; set green weight to 100 after green is healthy for 5 min.
Kubernetes rolling update strategy updates pods one by one and can cause brief errors if readiness probes are misconfigured.
candidate_memories.notes: note: rolling update is a different deployment strategy

candidate_memories.content: Canary deployment sends a small percentage of traffic to the new version first; this is a variant of blue-green but not what checkout-svc uses.
candidate_memories.notes: note: canary is a related but distinct approach

candidate_memories.content: checkout-svc v2.5 is staged in the green slot and has passed all smoke tests.
